candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 Vienna’s seafood scene has been such a pleasant surprise 🦑 Who would have thought that a landlocked city could serve seafood this exquisite? I stumbled upon this Italian restaurant before my VIVALDI: Vier Jahreszeiten performance at Karlskirche. Torn between the monkfish and grilled squid, I went with the waiter’s recommendation - and couldn’t have been happier. The grilled squid was succulent, incredibly fresh, and beautifully balanced. Hearty yet delicate, with the quality of the seafood speaking for itself. Honestly, I was blown away. ✨ Vienna’s location at the crossroads of Central Europe has historically made it an important trading hub, connecting different culinary traditions. And this little Italian restaurant was the perfect reminder that great seafood isn’t just found in coastal cities. I came here solo, otherwise I’d have loved to try more dishes. With its exquisite food and cozy, intimate atmosphere, this place is definitely worth a visit! #ViennaFood #ViennaEats #SeafoodLovers #ItalianFood #ViennaRestaurants

candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 European Eateries: Figlmüller, Vienna A Vienna classic, with a gluten-free twist. 🤍 We visited the original Figlmüller location to experience the restaurant famous for its iconic, oversized Wiener Schnitzel. candidateAudit.text: 🍿 Tee, der nach Popcorn schmeckt? Oh ja! Genmaicha ist grüner Tee mit geröstetem Reis. Beim Rösten poppen manche Körner auf, daher sein Spitzname Popcorn-Tee. Er schmeckt frisch und grün wie Sencha, dazu getoastet, nussig und ein bisschen herzhaft. Die Geschichte dahinter ist wunderschön: Grüntee war in Japan lange teuer, also streckte man die kostbaren Blätter mit geröstetem Reis. So wurde Genmaicha zum Alltagstee der einfachen Leute, mit weniger Koffein als reiner Grüntee und einem Aroma, das satt und zufrieden macht. Heute ist er ein Klassiker, der für seinen warmen, getreidigen Charakter geliebt wird. In unserem Latte trifft er auf cremige Hafermilch, ganz ohne Süße. Röstig, rund und genau richtig für alle, die es gemütlich mögen, aber nicht zuckrig. Hol dir deinen Latte jetzt an unserer Elixir Bar, sie ist Mittwoch bis Samstag für dich geöffnet. -> Neubaugasse 58, 1070 Wien 🍵 Pur oder als Latte, wie trinkst du deinen Tee am liebsten? #dancingshivavienna #elixirbar #genmaichalatte #pflanzenkraftwerk #viennaeats

candidateAudit.title: 🇦🇹 Vienna is known for its café culture, and rightfully so - from its grand, traditional coffeehouses to its modern cafés and brunch spots. ☕️ I was pleasantly surprised by OPal
candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 Vienna is known for its café culture, and rightfully so - from its grand, traditional coffeehouses to its modern cafés and brunch spots. ☕️ I was pleasantly surprised by OPal Eat & Drink and their selection of French galettes (buckwheat crêpes). I’ve always loved galettes and have tried them in France and Poland, so finding them in Vienna was such a delightful surprise! Knowing full well that I probably wouldn’t finish two, I couldn’t resist ordering two flavours: 🍄 Champignon - Mushrooms, Gouda cheese and sour cream, topped with a fried egg. Comforting, savoury and delicious, but a more classic combination. 🍎 Normande - Camembert, apples, thyme, walnuts and honey, also topped with a fried egg. And the Normande? Absolutely mind-blowing. The interplay of sweet and savoury was out of this world. The sweetness from the apples and honey wasn’t overwhelming; instead, it perfectly balanced the richness of the Camembert, the earthiness of the walnuts and the aromatic thyme. Every bite made me want another. It’s the kind of unexpected flavour combination that stays with you long after the meal - the sort of dish you find yourself reminiscing about. I couldn’t finish both in the end, so I packed the rest to take away. No food wasted! 😂 They offer plenty of other brunch options, but their extensive selection of galettes is undoubtedly the highlight. The spacious, comfortable interior also makes it a lovely place to slow down and enjoy a relaxed brunch. A definite recommendation if you’re exploring Vienna’s modern café scene. And if you go, get the Normande! 📍 OPal Eat & Drink, Vienna #ViennaFood #ViennaEats #ViennaBrunch #Galette #ViennaFoodie

candidateAudit.text: Griechisches Urlaubsfeeling mitten in der Donaustadt! 🇬🇷✨ Wir haben uns durch die Menükarte der Taverna Meraki (Quadenstraße 56) probiert – von frischen Mezedes und knusprigen Pita-Broten über saftige Fleischplatten mit Pommes bis hin zu süßen Highlights wie traditionellem Gebäck mit Eis. Dazu ein kühles Mythos und Eistee, und der Tag ist perfekt! Wer von euch liebt die griechische Küche genauso sehr wie wir? 👇 #wienfood #donaustadt #viennaeats #griechischessen #foodlover
